title: Battery storage reminders become FPVBuddy alerts delivered by NERV
goal: Storage reminders keep firing after the move: FPVBuddy raises them, NERV delivers them
acceptance: The reminders of src/battery-storage-reminders.ts keep their timing (21:00 the same day, after 5 days, then daily) and wording; FPVBuddy raises them as alerts and NERV delivers them through the alert contract built for Grover (F-122), or this record names exactly which side schedules them and why
Delivery is once per alert, survives a NERV restart without duplicates, and a cleared alert stops the daily repeat
A test across the join: a fake FPVBuddy MCP server raises a storage alert and NERV delivers it once through the stubbed channels
privacy: Owner fleet data stays local-only and never enters Git; tests use invented batteries, drones, crashes and photos.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
If FPVBuddy cannot raise alerts, the owner chooses which side schedules the reminders

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 after the owner decision (map the three reminder rules onto the F-122 alert contract and a join test with a fake MCP server). Not a measurement.
